model_annotation: Figure 10, titled "The effect of context masking on case tasks groupby by language family," is a grouped bar chart that illustrates the impact of the TARG and PERMUTE perturbations on case tasks across different language families. The horizontal axis displays eight language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, and Semitic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," is scaled from 0 to 30. For each language family, there are four bars representing different models: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light red), and XLM-R2 (dark red). The height of each bar indicates the magnitude of the effect, with error bars representing the standard deviation. The chart shows that the effect varies significantly across language families and models. For example, in the IE-Romance family, the mBERT-L2 model shows the highest effect, with a value exceeding 25, while the XLM-R2 model shows a much lower effect, around 10. In the IE-Slavic family, the mBERT-L2 model again shows a high effect, close to 25, whereas the XLM-R2 model's effect is approximately 10. The chart also highlights that the effects are generally lower for the Isolate and Semitic language families.
